newsitem.title: UK: UK headmaster's teenage killer prays for family.
newsitem.headline: UK headmaster's teenage killer prays for family.

text.p: The teenager convicted of stabbing a London headmaster in a killing that shocked Britain and sparked a moral crusade against rising crime said he was praying for the murdered man's family.
"I pray for the family every night and ask God to look over them," 16-year-old Learco Chindamo told The Sunday Times in a telephone interview from prison.
The interview sparked outrage among British members of parliament who said it would cause widespread distress.
Conservative Harry Greenway said: "It is outrageous that he is allowed to have publicity like this. He should not be seen and should not be heard."
Gang-leader Chindamo was sentenced to life imprisonment for stabbing Philip Lawrence, killed outside his school gates last December when he rushed to help a pupil.
He said he had often thought of writing to the teacher's widow, Frances Lawrence, who won widespread support when calling for tougher action against crime, including a ban on all knives.
"I feel very sorry for all the family, especially for the son, the little boy," Chindamo told the paper from the juvenile detention centre where is serving his term.
Last week, nine-year Lucien Lawrence unveiled a plaque to "My Daddy" at the school where his father was killed.
